answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the whisper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Work waits on the timber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the copper of the next round.
